How it works

Three steps.

  1. Upload or snap

    A PDF, Word (.docx), Pages, TXT or MD file up to 10 MB — or up to 6 photos of a paper document.

  2. Let it read

    The four sections appear together.

  3. Save the report

    Download it, or have it emailed to you.

ⓘ Scanned PDFs: up to 10 pages. Typed PDFs have no page limit. With photos, take one per side, up to 6 — a sheet printed on both sides counts as 2 pages.

FAQ

Common questions.

What kinds of documents work?
Most everyday documents — letters, leases, bills, statements, policies, school and work documents. For contracts you're about to sign, the Contract Analyzer in Workblox Business goes deeper.
Can I use photos of a paper document?
Yes. Take up to 6 photos, one per side, on a flat surface in good light.
Is it advice?
No. It summarizes what the document says and points out what to check. For legal, medical or money decisions, ask a professional.
Is my document stored?
No. Your document is read to produce your report and nothing is kept afterward. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Doc Analyzer is part of Workblox Personal. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $10/mo for 1–2 tools, $15/mo for 3–4 tools, or $20/mo for 5–7 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
